scenes.summary: The Mining Camp is extremely short on medication. The Endfield medical supplies probably met an accident during transportation. A girl named Lilica is in desperate need of help. Perlica decides to administer some emergency portable medication.

lines.text: Is it possible to order another batch of medical supplies? A smaller order will work. The medicine will be given to those who are most injured...
I also have other means to stabilize the rest. There might be side effects ... but at least it will save their lives.
We lost the batch of medication shortly after we delivered it to the UWST. Not many people knew about this caravan, so I'm not ruling out the possibility of a shipment accident.
Is there any other way? Can we move another batch of medication to deal with our current emergency...
Don't worry ... Molly will figure it out.
Lilica? Why are you here? You're hurt. Go lay down and get some rest.
Molly told me she'll find the medicine! She said I don't have to be scared!
Hi, little girl. Did Molly tell you where she went?
Quick! Help her onto the bed...!
She needs emergency treatment, but...
I have some emergency medication with me. We can use that first!
ENDMIN!

options: Perlica, any leads on our missing medication?
We'll deal with the medication issue.
It might help us find her...

scenes.summary: You help Lilica to her bed and find an ID belonging to Molly — someone Lilica mentioned.

lines.text: Here are the meds, Surgeon Yue.
Thank you!
Molly... Molly...
Molly... She sounds like someone very close to her...
There's an ID here.

scenes.summary: Molly is an outstanding UWST crew mate and she seems to be investigating the missing medical supplies. You decide that the top priority is to locate the lost medication.

lines.text: How is she doing?
The girl's condition has stabilized, but only temporarily.
We really need the medical supplies to treat the sick and injured in the Mining Camp.
If we run out of medication, the critical patients will be...
I'll do whatever I can to treat my patients with every medical resource we have right now. But if we run out of medicine ... the most we can do is to temporarily stabilize their condition.
The patients of the Mining Camp are in your hands. So, Endmin. I think we still have some time. What should be our next step?
The medical personnel have their hands full looking after the patients. We're counting on you to help us recover the medication, my Endfielder friends!
We received her profile data. Miss Molly qualified for the post of coordinator at a very young age. She also received stellar reviews in every aspect of her job.
Look at the work notes she took. She's a professional, and a meticulous one at that.
And it seems she ... actually went to the site where the caravan was ambushed. She was trying to investigate the meds.

options: Seems like someone capable of doing her job.
Our priority is to recover the missing medical supplies.

scenes.summary: You receive a UWST distress call from an abandoned meteorological station. The place has been occupied by the Landbreakers for a while. You decide to trace the call and head to the facility.

lines.text: Endmin! I picked up a strong distress call... The encryption pattern indicates it's from the UWST.
And it's sent from somewhere ... west of your location! It came from the meteorological station!
The meteorological station? But that site has been abandoned for ages... The Landbreakers occupied the place after the UWST withdrew.
The Landbreakers ... again...

options: Okay. Stay on this distress signal for us.
We should head over and take a look!

lines.text: Lilica's conditions have finally stabilized...
What's the situation at the meteorological station?
Alright. Be safe out there.

scenes.summary: Several UWST crew mates attempted to sneak into the meteorological station to recover the medical supplies. Unfortunately, they encountered the Landbreakers. Molly covered the retreat of three crew mates but ended up being captured by the raiders. You decide to follow the UWST crew into the facility and rescue Molly.

lines.text: You saved our lives! Those scab eaters almost killed us...
lines.who: Impulsive UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Impulsive UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: Can you please save Molly...? She volunteered to cover our retreat ... but if the breakers made it here, she's probably been captured by them!
lines.who: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: Can you tell us what happened?
We planned to sneak into the meteorological station and look for the medication. None of us expected the place to be so heavily guarded! It's crawling with LBs!
lines.who: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: We got in and looked around. Even got confirmed visuals of our medical supply crates, but then we alerted the breakers...
lines.who: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: Great! I'll lead the way!
lines.who: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: But your injuries...
It's just a flesh wound... We gotta move fast!
lines.who: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

options: We still have time to head in and retrieve the supplies.
We'll go in right now and save her.

lines.text: Molly... Dammit. We should have brought a bigger crew! We almost had it!
lines.who: Impulsive UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Impulsive UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: How did you find out where the supplies went?
Molly found clues about that medical shipment. We followed her here!
lines.who: Impulsive UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Impulsive UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: Sounds like you have faith in her.
Molly's our coordinator, but she's always there on the production floor with the crew. She showered us with plenty of care, so it's only natural we trust her.
lines.who: Impulsive UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Impulsive UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: Hey, let me tag along as well!
lines.who: Desperate UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Desperate UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: Your injuries look too severe. You should head back to the camp.
I was the one who startled the LBs and botched everything... I can never forgive myself if anything happens to her.
lines.who: Desperate UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Desperate UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: It's not really your fault.
She told me to leave, and I did. I can't believe it... I'm such a blighted coward!
lines.who: Desperate UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Desperate UWST Crew Mate}

scenes.summary: Fiona sends you the plans and layouts of this area. She mentions an abandoned sewer line that is perfect for sneaking into the meteorological station. You tell the UWST crew to head back and prepare yourself for the infiltration mission.

lines.text: There are way more LBs here than we thought. They obviously strengthened their guards after we left...
lines.who: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

lines.text: Fiona, do we have any more intel?
The plans of this area indicate an abandoned sewer tunnel. You can use that to sneak in. I'm sending you the data right now.
Much appreciated.
According to the plans, this sewer tunnel is indeed perfect for infiltration.
It should have been abandoned for a while. I don't think the Landbreakers would pay much attention to it.
What do you think, Endmin?
You're still wounded. Maybe you should head back and get some rest.
Okay. We're counting on you for this. Please bring Molly back!
lines.who: Worried UWST Crew Mate {sm1l6m1-Worried UWST Crew Mate}

options: The sewers are the end of the entire cosmos.
It's urgent. Dive in first. Ask questions later.
